name: DIG-ROCK -Documentary of Youthful Sounds-
source:
Actors, models, idols, voice actors… Dignity Production is a talent agency that manages a number of popular talents.

Following its recent expansion, the agency has seen remarkable growth.

There is Impish Crow, a rookie band that aims to fly even higher; and RUBIA Leopard, an overwhelmingly popular band that continues to gain momentum.

Tasked with creating a documentary about them, you follow them closely for a month until their outdoor concert.

How you depict them—who live solely for music—is up to you.

[from [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2022/01/otome-visual-novel-dig-rock-documentary-of-youthful-sounds-announced-for-switch]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
演员、模特、偶像、配音演员……Dignity Production是一家经纪公司，管理着众多人气艺人。

经过最近的扩张，该机构取得了显着的增长。

还有Impish Crow，一支志在飞得更高的新人乐队；RUBIA Leopard是一支极受欢迎的乐队，且势头持续强劲。

你的任务是制作一部关于他们的纪录片，你密切关注他们一个月，直到他们的户外音乐会。

如何描绘他们——只为音乐而活的人——取决于你。

[来自[url=https://www.gematsu.com/2022/01/otome-visual-novel-dig-rock-documentary-of-youthful-sounds-announced-for-switch]Gematsu[/url]]
